paragraphs: Do you know my grandparents? They live on a farm. The farm is in a small village in the countryside. It has a big green field. There are three cows and a lot of chickens. Their house is old. It has a red roof. Grandma is Mom's mother. So Mom is her daughter, and I'm her granddaughter. Uncle Dan is her son.

My grandfather has a favorite seat under a big tree. He sits there every afternoon. He has a cup of tea. He looks at the field and the cows. Grandma likes the kitchen. She makes rice, soup, and sweet fruit. I go to the farm in the school holidays. I walk in the field with my brother Tom. Grandpa shows us the chickens. They are small and funny. It is a happy place.

The farm is not near our house in the city. So we talk on the internet every Saturday. They see us, and we see them. Grandma sends me a message with a photo of the cows. I send her a message with a photo of Pip. Grandpa always says, "Come to the farm!" I love my grandparents, and I love the farm.
text.summary: Lily tells us about her grandparents. They live on a farm in the countryside, and the family talks on the internet every Saturday.
